pairing: Same parent directory, dataset boundary and entities; run indices compare numerically, subject/session labels lexically.
timing: Positive finite phase1 EchoTime < phase2 EchoTime. If a magnitude EchoTime is present it must equal its numbered phase EchoTime.
relationships: Every member depends on the other three. Existing explicit B0 and IntendedFor links select consumers; family pairing does not infer consumers.

cases.name: ambiguous-phase
cases.mutation: add compressed copy of phase1 image

cases.name: ambiguous-magnitude
cases.mutation: add compressed copy of magnitude2 image

cases.name: missing-reference-target
cases.mutation: change phase1 IntendedFor to an absent BOLD path

cases.name: mixed-representation
cases.mutation: add phasediff with the same directory/entities

cases.name: separate-phasediff
cases.mutation: add complete phasediff family with acq-other

cases.name: separate-epi
